questions.prompt: What was the average global total fertility rate (births per woman) in 2023?
questions.insight: World fertility has fallen from about 5 births per woman in 1960 to near the 2.1 replacement level today.

questions.prompt: As of 2020, what percentage of the world's population were international migrants (people living outside their country of birth)?
questions.insight: Despite migration's high public profile, international migrants remain a small share of humanity — roughly 1 in 28 people.

questions.prompt: On average, how many million hectares of forest are cleared globally each year, based on the most recent five-year period (2015-2020)?
questions.insight: Annual deforestation has fallen for three straight decades, from about 16 million hectares/year in the 1990s to roughly 10 million today.

questions.prompt: What was the average CO2 emissions per person worldwide in 2023, in tonnes?

source.name: Global Carbon Project (via Our World in Data)

questions.insight: Global per-capita CO2 emissions have stayed just below 5 tonnes for over a decade, masking huge gaps between high- and low-emitting countries.

questions.prompt: What percentage of the world's population used the internet in 2024?
questions.insight: 5.5 billion people are now online, but 2.6 billion people, mostly in low-income countries, still lack internet access.
